chunks.text:
[Post 1/5]
1/5 🚨 THREAT INTEL: CVE-2026-4418 zero-day actively weaponized against enterprise identity gateways. State-linked actor "Midnight Storm" has compromised 34 global enterprises within 72 hours. Here is the technical breakdown and mitigation protocol.

[Post 2/5]
2/5 THE VECTOR: Attackers compromise edge TLS termination proxies and deploy an eBPF kernel rootkit. This allows real-time scraping of OAuth bearer tokens and SAML assertions directly out of memory, completely bypassing standard FIDO2 token binding.

[Post 3/5]
3/5 THE SPEED: Observability logs record a terrifying 18-minute mean time from initial gateway breach to tenant-wide administrative privilege escalation. Exfiltration uses stealth DNS tunneling over port 53 disguised as routine system telemetry.

[Post 4/5]
4/5 IMMEDIATE MITIGATION ACTIONS:
• Revoke ALL active session refresh tokens globally
• Enforce 15-minute ephemeral token lifetimes
• Run cryptographic verification on loaded eBPF programs
• Rotate identity provider root signing keys

[Post 5/5]
5/5 We have synthesized the full threat package into an executive brief, slide presentation, and technical advisory checklist for engineering leads. Stay fortified.
